prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic studio portrait of an adult masculine-presenting person using the provided adult image as a facial reference. The adult subject has soft black wavy hair, brown eyes, a subtle short beard, natural skin tones, and wears a fitted charcoal-black T-shirt. Seat the subject at a reflective glass table with both hands resting symmetrically on the surface, creating a perfect vertical mirror reflection below. Compose like a King of Spades playing card against a clean deep-maroon background, with a black K above a black spade in the top-left and the mirrored King of Spades mark in the bottom-right. Use soft diffused studio light, sharp focus, high-end fashion photography, cinematic mood, clean background, and realistic textures.
